items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: I'm going to ask Val Valvera. He's a very good musician... I went up and asked him. And he said, how did you know?

ctx.x: Wasn't any of that arm business.

We win alms. And when you are with two love. That's another one. I wish somebody, a lot of them old pieces are coming back. I sit out on the sidewalk at night and listen to them at the jukebox at the corner. And they're playing so nice and classical and sentimental and all of a sudden you hit them. And I think they're starting to rag to try and do jazz it. But the thing is, they only jazz the chorus. Just like they did Sunday at the park. Now I'm going to pick out a piece Sunday. I don't know what it's going to…
You were telling him how to do it. Yeah.
